description: Load a Playwright run that happened elsewhere (a CI job's JSON report, a folder of blob reports from shards, or a GitHub Actions / GitLab CI run URL) so get-failure, suggest-fix and diagnose-flaky work on it like a local run. CI paths are mapped onto this checkout and traces are found in the unpacked test-results artifact; the run is recorded in the history with its commit.

commit.description: Commit the run tested (default: read from the report metadata)

record.description: Add the run to the local history for analyze-history (default true)

report.description: JSON report or blob-report folder inside the project, or a GitHub Actions run / GitLab job URL (needs GITHUB_TOKEN / GITLAB_TOKEN)

traceDirs.description: Folders inside the project where the job's test-results artifact was unpacked (default: the report's folder and its parent)

name: load-report
title: Load a CI report
